entries.name: National Veterinary Emergency Service helpline (Servizz.gov, freephone 153 ext. 22)
entries.duty: 24/7 emergency helpline: call freephone 153 and choose extension 22; staff assess the case and refer you to suitable veterinary help. Out-of-hours emergency clinics rotate across Gozo, northern and southern Malta, nightly 8pm-8am and Sundays/public holidays.

duty_i18n.hr: Hitna linija 24/7: nazovi besplatni broj 153 i odaberi lokal 22; osoblje procjenjuje slučaj i upućuje te na odgovarajuću veterinarsku pomoć. Hitne klinike izvan radnog vremena izmjenjuju se između Gozoa te sjevernog i južnog dijela Malte, svake noći 20–8 h te nedjeljom i na blagdane.
duty_i18n.de: Notfall-Hotline rund um die Uhr: gebührenfrei 153 wählen, dann Nebenstelle 22; das Personal beurteilt den Fall und verweist an geeignete tierärztliche Hilfe. Die Notdienstkliniken außerhalb der Sprechzeiten wechseln sich auf Gozo sowie im Norden und Süden Maltas ab, nachts 20–8 Uhr sowie sonn- und feiertags.
duty_i18n.fr: Ligne d’urgence 24 h/24, 7 j/7 : appelez le 153 (numéro gratuit) puis choisissez le poste 22 ; l’équipe évalue le cas et vous oriente vers une aide vétérinaire adaptée. Des cliniques d’urgence de garde se relaient entre Gozo, le nord et le sud de Malte, chaque nuit 20 h–8 h et les dimanches et jours fériés.
duty_i18n.es: Línea de urgencias 24/7: llama al número gratuito 153 y elige la extensión 22; el personal valora el caso y te remite a la ayuda veterinaria adecuada. Las clínicas de urgencias fuera de horario rotan entre Gozo, el norte y el sur de Malta, cada noche 20:00–8:00 h y domingos y festivos.

entries.note: Veterinary Surgeons Council pages vsc.gov.mt/?p=970 and home page opened: heading '24/7 - Emergency Service', freephone 153 ext 22, run by Servizz.gov. Rota hours from EOI page vsc.gov.mt/?p=963 (nights, Sundays, public holidays; Gozo/North/South rotation) and news articles (Malta Independent 2025-07-01, Malta Daily, Maltese Herald: nightly 8pm-8am from 26 Jan 2026). No published rota of which clinic is on duty found; owners are triaged via 153. City set to Valletta as national service (no physical location). Independent check 2026-11-05: vsc.gov.mt/?p=970 re-opened; heading '24/7 - Emergency Service', freephone 153 ext 22 confirmed.

entries.name: National Veterinary Emergency Service - out-of-hours clinic (Reggie Miller Square)
entries.duty: Out-of-hours emergency clinic, 8pm-8am; call the 153 ext. 22 helpline first.

duty_i18n.hr: Hitna klinika izvan radnog vremena, 20–8 h; prvo nazovi liniju 153, lokal 22.
duty_i18n.de: Notdienstklinik außerhalb der Sprechzeiten, 20–8 Uhr; bitte zuerst die Hotline 153, Nebenstelle 22, anrufen.
duty_i18n.fr: Clinique d’urgence de garde, 20 h–8 h ; appelez d’abord la ligne d’urgence 153, poste 22.
duty_i18n.es: Clínica de urgencias fuera de horario, 20:00–8:00 h; llama antes a la línea 153 ext. 22.

entries.note: MaltaToday article (opened) says an emergency vet clinic opens at Reggie Miller Square, Fgura, 8pm-8am; operator and phone not stated; article date unknown, may be superseded by regional rota. Not a 24h clinic. Independent check 2026-11-05: article re-opened; address and 8pm-8am hours confirmed, no phone and no 24h in article; 153 ext 22 comes from vsc.gov.mt/?p=970 (helpline to call first). Register also lists 'The Veterinary Clinic, 7 Wesgha Reggie Miller, Fgura'.

entries.name: Veterinary Emergency transport for small pets (Gozo)
entries.duty: Gozo: on Sundays and public holidays a standby transport takes small pets in genuine emergencies to a clinic in Malta; call the national emergency line first.

duty_i18n.hr: Gozo: nedjeljom i na blagdane pripravni prijevoz u stvarnim hitnim slučajevima prevozi male ljubimce u kliniku na Malti; prvo nazovi nacionalni hitni broj.
duty_i18n.de: Gozo: Sonn- und feiertags bringt ein Bereitschaftstransport Kleintiere in echten Notfällen zu einer Tierklinik auf Malta; bitte zuerst die nationale Notrufnummer anrufen.
duty_i18n.fr: Gozo : les dimanches et jours fériés, un transport de permanence emmène les petits animaux en cas d’urgence réelle vers une clinique à Malte ; appelez d’abord la ligne nationale d’urgence.
duty_i18n.es: Gozo: domingos y festivos, un transporte de guardia lleva a las mascotas pequeñas en urgencias reales a una clínica de Malta; llama antes a la línea nacional de urgencias.

entries.note: Malta Independent article (opened, 2026-05-11): standby transport Sundays/public holidays from a marked Gozo site. Location not stated; kept as an info entry, not a clinic. Independent check 2026-11-05: article re-opened; Sundays/public holidays standby transport confirmed, no phone or location in article; 153 ext 22 from vsc.gov.mt/?p=970.

notes: No animal poison information line for Malta found (vsd.gov.mt/?p=6028 opened: no poisoning line; advice is to contact a vet / 153 ext 22). No public clinic-by-clinic duty rota found; the 153 ext 22 helpline triages and refers. No clinic page was opened that explicitly says 24 hours, so no clinic is marked 24h; the helpline is marked 24h because the VSC page is headed '24/7 - Emergency Service'. Ta' Qali national animal hospital: MaltaToday says closed since Aug 2023, current status unverified, not listed. Own websites of clinics could not be fetched (WebFetch provenance restriction: only URLs seen in search/fetch results are allowed; clinic sites never appeared) - hence phones come from the yellow.com.mt directory for register-licensed clinics; verify before publishing. Register clinics left out for lack of a reliable phone/url: Best Friends (Tarxien, directory lists Paola number - conflict), Animal Doctors Hamrun (conflicting numbers), The Animal Doctor and Dr William's Vet Surgery (Victoria, Gozo), Dr Trevor's Attard, Pets Vet Clinic Zabbar, St Francis Zurrieq, Healthy Pets/Drs Borg Birkirkara, St Anne's Swieqi, Animal Kingdom Paola, Pet Medical Clinic Qormi, Il-Veterinarju Mosta, Vet 4 Pet Zebbug, QVC Marsaskala, Tat-Targa Naxxar, Vets on Wheels Marsa, My Pet San Gwann, Fgura clinic. Consultancy practices in Mellieha (The Pet Practice, Pet Centre), St Paul's Bay/Qawra/Bugibba (several), Rabat, Zejtun, Burmarrad also have no phone/url. Marsaxlokk and Valletta: no licensed clinic found in either register. Unreachable by provenance: agriculture.gov.mt, animalmedicalcentremalta.com, vetcaremalta.com.
